scope: Targeted primary-source review for round13; no exhaustive-literature claim.

primary_sources.title: Yang-Mills & the Mass Gap
primary_sources.limitations: Status page is not a proof audit.

primary_sources.title: Quantum Yang-Mills Theory
primary_sources.reading_depth: Sections 1–5, especially Section 4; regulator discussion inherited from round12
primary_sources.supports: Required target: nontrivial four-dimensional pure theory and physical spectral gap
primary_sources.limitations: Historical overview is not a current literature census.

primary_sources.title: Quasi-Locality Bounds for Quantum Lattice Systems. Part I. Lieb-Robinson Bounds, Quasi-Local Maps, and Spectral Flow Automorphisms
primary_sources.authors: Bruno Nachtergaele; Robert Sims; Amanda Young
primary_sources.reading_depth: Introduction; Sections 2.3, 3.1–3.3; Theorems 3.3–3.5 and Corollary 3.6; selected recursive proof
primary_sources.supports: Unbounded on-site terms and bounded interactions; topology distinctions; boundary estimates
primary_sources.limitations: Selected sections, not a complete 106-page audit. Project constants require independent derivation. HTML rendering date is not version date.

primary_sources.title: Bootstrap for Finite N Lattice Yang-Mills Theory
primary_sources.reading_depth: Sections 1–3; SU(2) trace relation; moment positivity; hierarchy description
primary_sources.supports: Finite-N trace identities and positive observable matrices
primary_sources.limitations: No numerical optimizer or published certificate independently replayed here; finite hierarchy is not full continuum construction.

primary_sources.title: A stochastic analysis approach to lattice Yang--Mills at strong coupling
primary_sources.authors: Hao Shen; Rongchan Zhu; Xiangchan Zhu
primary_sources.reading_depth: Abstract/version; main assumptions; selected Hessian and functional-inequality discussion; detailed normalization inherited from round12 volume review
primary_sources.supports: Strong-coupling fixed-spacing scope and beta normalization
primary_sources.limitations: Not a real-time Hamiltonian gap proof or weak-coupling continuum limit.

primary_sources.title: Center-stabilized Yang-Mills theory: confinement and large N volume independence
primary_sources.reading_depth: Abstract; Section 2 action/center symmetry/volume independence; selected Section 3 monopole-gas description
primary_sources.supports: Concrete deformation parameters and compactification route
primary_sources.limitations: Semiclassical and large-N statements have separate assumptions; no independent uniform decompactification proof here.

primary_sources.title: Closed formula for Wilson loops for SU(N) Quantum Yang-Mills Theory in two dimensions
primary_sources.authors: Abhay Ashtekar; Jurek Lewandowski; Donald Marolf; José Mourão; Thomas Thiemann
primary_sources.supports: Rigorous 2D model as scoped reconstruction benchmark
primary_sources.limitations: Abstract scope only; full proof not reviewed.

primary_sources.title: Invariant measure and universality of the 2D Yang-Mills Langevin dynamic
primary_sources.limitations: Abstract scope only; 165-page proof not audited.

primary_sources.title: Stochastic quantisation of Yang-Mills-Higgs in 3D
primary_sources.authors: Ajay Chandra; Ilya Chevyrev; Martin Hairer; Hao Shen
primary_sources.supports: Local stochastic-time YMH construction and possible blow-up
primary_sources.limitations: Additional fields, changed dimension; full proof not audited.

primary_sources.title: Uniqueness of gauge covariant renormalisation of stochastic 3D Yang-Mills-Higgs
primary_sources.supports: Uniqueness of gauge-covariant renormalization in specified 3D model
primary_sources.limitations: Counterterm is not a freely inserted physical gauge-boson mass.

primary_sources.title: Scaling limit of the 3D abelian Yang--Mills Langevin dynamics
primary_sources.authors: Ilya Chevyrev; Yahui Qu; Hao Shen
primary_sources.supports: Recent Abelian weak-coupling local stochastic-time scaling
primary_sources.limitations: Abelian and 3D; no nonabelian 4D gap implication.

primary_sources.title: Properties and uses of the Wilson flow in lattice QCD
primary_sources.supports: Flow time as smoothing scale; importance of corrected analysis versions
primary_sources.limitations: Not a physical-time evolution or a proof of the Yang-Mills gap. No code replay.

primary_sources.title: Quasi-particles in weak perturbations of non-interacting quantum lattice systems
primary_sources.reading_depth: Definitions and Theorems 1–3, pp.2–4; selected Section 2 expansion and references 23–24
primary_sources.supports: Infinite-dimensional on-site product-vacuum gap stability with bounded finite-range perturbations
primary_sources.limitations: Existential smallness constants only; full cluster expansion not independently rebuilt; quasiparticle results not imported.
